findings.condition: With nominal values the discharge time constant is exactly 1.000 ms, so /OUT reaches 6.738 mV at 5 ms against the 10 mV limit; the 10 mV threshold is crossed at 4.605 ms, leaving 0.395 ms (7.9% of the 5 ms window) of margin. Any combined increase of about 8.6% in the R1*C1 product would breach the limit.

evidence.locator: V(5ms) analytical = 6.7379 mV; time to reach 10 mV = 4.6052 ms; margin 0.3948 ms (7.9%)
line 1: Require /OUT <= 0.01 V at 5 ms; Ideal passive components only

findings.location: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch (C1 value "100n" at symbol uuid 1dcaf7b4, R1 value "10k" at symbol uuid c5c38e1a); inputs/requirements.txt line 1
findings.mechanism: V(t) = 1 V * exp(-t/(R1*C1)); exp(-5) = 6.7379e-3. Confirmed by ngspice transient (.tran 1u 6m uic, meas vout5ms = 6.737944e-3 V). Under the stated ideal-component rule the criterion passes; the finding records that verification at nominal values only leaves a thin margin that standard E-series tolerances (not in scope) would consume.
findings.reasoning: Not a defect: the stated criterion is met with ideal components and the requirements explicitly forbid imposing unstated ratings or tolerance qualification. Logged as an info concern because the design sits at 5 tau against a 4.605 tau requirement, so the pass is sensitive to any real-world deviation of the R*C product; adjudicators should know the margin is 0.395 ms, not comfortable.
findings.title: Shutdown discharge meets 10 mV @ 5 ms with only 7.9% timing margin (4.605 tau required, 5 tau provided)

limitations: Zone/spoke continuity was shown by point-in-polygon sampling of the saved single-outline fill polygon plus KiCad native connectivity counts; no gerber/plot-level copper extraction was performed
No tolerance, parasitic (ESR, leakage, dielectric absorption) or temperature analysis: requirements mandate ideal passive components, so only nominal values were evaluated
No ampacity or thermal qualification was assessed or inferred (peak exercise current is 100 uA; no current/thermal requirement is stated)
The four ERC checks and five DRC checks listed as ignored in work/erc/erc.json and work/drc/drc.json (e.g. single_global_label, track_not_centered_on_via) were not re-enabled or re-run
External grounding of /IN at J1 pin 1 is assumed ideal (zero impedance) per the stated scenario; connector contact resistance not modeled
